Two-sample Hotelling T-squared statistic

Source: R/utils.R
hotelling_T2.Rd

Computes the classical two-sample Hotelling \(T^2\) statistic comparing the means of the rows of X assigned to cluster k1 versus cluster k2, using a pooled (ridge-stabilized) covariance estimate.

Usage

hotelling_T2(X, cl, k1, k2, ridge = 1e-08)

Arguments

X

A numeric data matrix with observations in rows.

cl

Integer/character vector of cluster labels, one per row of X.

k1, k2

The two cluster labels to compare.

ridge

Small non-negative ridge added to the diagonal of the pooled covariance for numerical stability.

Value

A single numeric \(T^2\) value, or NA_real_ if either cluster has fewer than two members.

Examples

set.seed(1)
X <- matrix(rnorm(40), 20, 2)
cl <- rep(1:2, each = 10)
hotelling_T2(X, cl, 1, 2)
#> [1] 0.6052868
